author: More Perfect Union
description:
Bettors on Kalshi and Polymarket are waging nearly $1 billion on the Super Bowl.

But according to Kalshi’s CEO, what they’re doing isn’t actually sports betting - it’s "trading."

What’s behind the marketing ploy? Dodging taxes and regulation, of course.
title: $1 Billion Bet on the Super Bowl: What Kalshi and Polymarket Don’t Want You to Know
